places.name: South Downs Way (Hassocks to Lewes)
places.saving_hack: Off-Peak Return to Lewes + short Single (Brighton-Hassocks)
places.last_transit_note: Sunset ~18:05! Last direct Brighton->Southampton train at 21:02
places.payment_rule: Railcard on App | Emergency Breeze Bus 79 at Beacon (£2 Card)
places.ticket_info: Free National Trail - Bring 2L water (no shops on ridge)
places.highlights: Jack & Jill Windmills, Ditchling Beacon 360° summit, Lewes Castle
places.notes: Station-to-station linear hike across the South Downs chalk ridge.

places.payment_rule: Contactless / Apple Pay accepted on bus
places.highlights: Iconic cobbled Gold Hill street, Blackmore Vale panoramic views
places.notes: Train to Gillingham (Dorset) then local bus.

places.name: Bath (Roman Baths & Royal Crescent)
places.community_tag: UNESCO World Heritage / National Trust Skyline
places.saving_hack: Direct GWR Train from Southampton Central with Railcard (1h 25m - No changes!)
places.last_transit_note: Direct GWR trains back to Southampton run hourly until ~22:20 from Bath Spa!
places.payment_rule: Contactless OK everywhere | Show Railcard on GWR train
places.ticket_info: City & Pulteney Bridge free | Roman Baths: Book student ticket online
places.highlights: Roman Baths, Royal Crescent, Pulteney Bridge, National Trust Bath Skyline walk

places.name: Girona / Costa Brava (Extreme Day Trip)
places.saving_hack: £18 Return Flight from Bournemouth (BOH) - No hotel needed!
places.last_transit_note: Airport Bus to Girona Centre takes 20 mins (€2.75)
places.payment_rule: Contactless OK on Girona buses; validate paper rail tickets!
places.highlights: Game of Thrones medieval streets, Onyar River houses, Spanish tapas
places.notes: Direct cheap flight from Bournemouth Airport.

places.name: Tryfan & Llyn Idwal (Snowdonia)
places.saving_hack: Advance train booking to Bangor (Gwynedd) with Railcard + T10 / Sherpa bus into Ogwen Cottage
places.last_transit_note: TrawsCymru T10 bus from Ogwen Cottage back to Bangor station ends early evening
places.ticket_info: Free public access; proper mountain boots and waterproof layers essential
places.highlights: Glacial cirque at Llyn Idwal, dramatic scrambling on Tryfan ridge, and panoramic Ogwen Valley views
places.notes: Classic Snowdonia mountain route. Best tackled over a weekend stay in Bangor or Betws-y-Coed rather than a single day trip from Southampton.

checkpoints.task: Train from Southampton Central to Bangor via Chester / Birmingham
Take Sherpa/T10 bus from Bangor to Ogwen Cottage trailhead
Follow the trail around Llyn Idwal towards the Glyderau ridge
